messages:
marta_pm: Quick sync — I pulled together a proposed set of launch gates for Console observability (dashboards, traces, cost breakdown, error analytics). Needs product + eng + telemetry sign-off. TL;DR: MVP = 3 dashboards + tracing hook + cost per-route + alerting for regressions. See acceptance checklist below.

kenny_eng: We need to lock trace sampling and latency budget. Can we commit to 100ms p95 for the inference API spans? :thinking_face: If not, we should mark latency dashboards as 'monitor-only' for MVP.

jinx_telemetry: Sampling proposal: start with 1% full-trace capture + 100% lightweight trace metadata (trace_id, span_id, duration, model_id). Increase to 5-10% on canaries or customer opt-in. Instrumentation snippet: ```span("serve_inference").set_tag("model_id", model).set_tag("seq_len", seq_len)```

olivia_pm: Customer asks summary: enterprise customers want cost visibility by model + route + customer-tag. Also CSV export of cost reports and a link from errors -> traces. This is a frequent win.

sam_finance: Cost calc note: show both "estimated billed" (tokens * unit_price) and "infra allocation" (amortized GPU cost). We need a toggle to display/exclude infra share for clarity.

sre_bot: incidentbot: alert created - observability-ingest-drop (ingest < 90% expected) — tagging oncall.

marc_ds: Recommend KPIs: 
- Time-to-detect (median): target < 2m for sev1
- Time-to-root-cause (median): target < 30m for sev1
- Alert precision: target > 80%
We should surface these on the ops dashboard.

raj_customer_success: From customers: they want error analytics that groups by signal (root cause) not by raw exception string. Example ask: group by stack + model_id + input-shingle. They'll pay for an "Error Insights" add-on.

marta_pm: Proposed acceptance checklist:
- Dashboards: throughput, latency per-model, cost per-route (CSV export)
- Tracing: standard span names + context propagation + sampling policy documented
- Error analytics: grouping by root cause, anomaly flagging, trace links
- Exports: CSV + API endpoint for programmatic pulls
- Rollout: canary to 10% accounts, 50% after 2w with no regressions
Can we mark which items are blocker vs nice-to-have?

kenny_eng: Blockers (must-have for launch):
1) Sampling strategy confirmed and documented
2) Retention plan + infra cost estimate for metrics/traces
3) Private deployments: ensure no data leaves VPC by default
Everything else is P1/P2 and can be phased.

olivia_pm: I'll push CSV export and group-by UX as top priorities for product. Can we ship a basic cost breakdown (tokens + infra share) without per-user billing columns in MVP? That reduces scope.

marta_pm: Agreed — keep per-user billing out of MVP. Action items: @kenny_eng sampling + retention doc by EOD Thu; @jinx_telemetry span spec PR by Mon; @marc_ds KPI definitions + dashboard mockups by Fri. I'll update the roadmap doc after this thread and call a 30-min sync if there are blockers. :thumbsup:

kenny_eng: ack — will add PR link once ready.
